Description: Two-level state machine per creature: the intent (WildlifeMind: roam, forage, drink, rest, sleep, alert, investigate, threaten, hunt, defend, flee, feed) and animation-timed actions inside it (Choreographer: notice, roar, startle, stalk, chase, bolt, look around, sniff, poop, settle, wake). Carnivores hunt at night, sleep the morning and roam the afternoon; herbivores sleep at night. Per-individual reaction delays, speeds, formation slots and clip rates end the lockstep herds. Turn-limited movement with in-place pivots and turn clips; gait playback from measured foot speed; 147 behaviour clips imported (tools/build_behavior_clips.py). Flyers: nest laps (loop, figure eight, thermal) and perch look-around; aquatic kept simple (cruise, hover, no thirst). Habitats (temperate, wetland, cold, sea, sky) replace the biome difficulty.
